purpose: Controlled refinement prompted by training/validation failure to learn the full Hamiltonian gradient. Retain the exact original Hamiltonian and conservative solver; learn only the positive current-gated mobility from longer training trajectories.
decision_basis: The two full learned-energy candidates had normalized conservative validation MSE near one. This hybrid was specified using those training/validation logs, before the hybrid test arrays are scored. The previously frozen three-model results are retained without retuning.
inputs: Eleven common-phase-invariant radial features plus the exact native Hamiltonian phase torque. No exact native current or mobility at inference. Training-only feature normalization, mean radial mobility and observed support are recorded.
labels: Unit-kappa equal-and-opposite phase rates, heat cells, and explicit unit mobility from training only. Loss = normalized phase/heat MSE + 0.1 normalized mobility MSE. It is supervised constitutive approximation with known H, not recovery of an unknown full law.
factorization: c_nn = c_base(r)*softplus(DCT(features,D)); phase_C_dot=-kappa*c_nn*D; phase_R_dot=+kappa*c_nn*D; heat_i=kappa*c_nn*D^2. This guarantees the native instantaneous power identity and nonnegative heat for kappa>=0.
selection: Validation-only checkpoint, freeze and hash before hybrid test scoring. One training seed; no statistical superiority claim.
limits: Native mechanics and native H are still evaluated. No acceleration, continuum or experimental physical claim. Success is limited to this manufactured radial initial-condition family and checked horizon.
